dialog.purposeHelp: Chaza ukuthi ukusekelwa kucelwa ukwenzani. Phakathi kwezinhlamvu ezingu-10 no-500.

table.emptyHistory: Azikho izabelo zangaphambilini okwamanje. Izabelo ezikhanseliwe nezaphelelwa yisikhathi zibonakala lapha.

supportAccess.noActiveGrant: Akukho kufinyelela kokusekela okusebenzayo. Akekho ongaphandle kwale pod ongangena manje.
